newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $12.2 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $12.2 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold 250 million rupees ($12.2 million) of treasury bills during its weekly auction, the same amount it tendered, the bank said on Thursday.

It said that for this week's auction, it sold 74 million rupees of 91-day, 82 million rupees of 182-day and 94 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.36 percent, 9.36 percent and 9.58 percent, respectively.
This week's effective bank rate has been posted at 9.69 percent per annum from 9.82 percent last week, the bank said.
Last week, the bank sold 228.1 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.53 percent, 9.47 percent and 9.69 percent, respectively.
